name: Universal File Saver
description: Turn any pasted text, code or config snippet into a real downloadable file — pick a category, pick an extension, and download in one click.
body:
Preview

Your file content will preview here.
howto: Pick the category that matches your file type — the extension list updates automatically.
Choose the exact extension (or type a custom one with the Other category).
Give the file a name and paste in your content, or load a starter template.
Preview the content on the right to double-check it.
Click Download file to save it with the correct extension.
features: Category-grouped extension picker — Code, Documents, Data & Config, Web and Other
Six starter templates: HTML, README, JSON, .env, CSS reset and Python
Live content preview while you type

faq.q: What file types can I save?
faq.a: Any text-based file: source code, config, markdown, data, scripts, documents. If it is plain text, this tool can save it. For binary files (images, video), use the dedicated image or file tools instead.
Nowhere. Everything is processed in your browser and the file is created locally with the Blob API. Nothing is uploaded to a server.

faq.q: Can I save files without an extension?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the Other category and leave the extension field empty, or type any custom extension you need.

faq.q: Do the templates contain anything proprietary?
faq.a: No. The templates are plain public boilerplate that anyone can write — simple HTML, markdown README, JSON, .env, CSS reset and a basic Python script.
